title: Can You Say This for Me? Speaking Up by Proxy in Co-Located Discussion
abstract: arXiv:2608.26185v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Equal participation in co-located discussion is important for effective collaboration, yet people often hold back when they anticipate negative interpersonal or professional consequences, especially when raising a point requires voicing it themselves. We present SecondVoice, a mixed-reality system that enables people to speak up through an embodied virtual proxy. By separating what is said from who says it, SecondVoice brings hesitant points into the live spoken discussion without putting the speaker on the spot. Using a private overlay, users specify their intent through a structured specification process rather than composing a full utterance. The system reformulates the input and voices it into the conversation through the proxy. We characterize a design space of participation channels under social risk. translated_title: 你能替我说吗？在共处讨论中通过代理发声
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26185v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在共处讨论中平等参与对于有效协作至关重要，但人们常常在预见到负面的人际或职业后果时选择保留意见，尤其是当提出观点需要自己亲口说出时。我们提出了SecondVoice，一个混合现实系统，使用户能够通过一个具身的虚拟代理来表达自己。通过将所说内容与说话者身份分离，SecondVoice将犹豫不决的观点引入现场口头讨论，而不让发言者处于尴尬境地。利用私密覆盖层，用户通过结构化指定流程来表达意图，而非构建完整的语句。系统会重新表述输入内容，并通过代理将其发声到对话中。我们刻画了在社会风险下参与渠道的设计空间。在一项初步的受试者内研究（N=16）中，我们将完整的SecondVoice系统与匿名文本板渠道进行了比较。
tldr: 本文提出SecondVoice混合现实系统，通过虚拟代理分离发言内容与身份，让用户在共处讨论中无需亲自开口即可安全表达犹豫观点，从而促进平等参与。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SecondVoice, a mixed-reality system that separates speech content from speaker identity via an embodied proxy, enabling hesitant participants to voice opinions in co-located discussions without personal exposure.
